name: web-beauty-salon-case-study-on-chocolate-brown
title: Salon website case study on chocolate brown with cream sticker labels
whatItIs: A deep brown slide with a large cream two-line title, a project description and result paragraph in bold-led lines, and a laptop showing a pink beauty-salon site. A cream outline-sticker script 'project 4' and a floral asterisk sticker overlap the laptop.
whatItMeans: Warm, sweet and confident; brown-and-cream framing lets a pastel site shine.
techniques: Frame a pastel website on a dark chocolate background for contrast.
Use bold lead-ins ('About the project:', 'Result:') in a text block.
Add outlined script stickers that overlap the device.

vocabulary.definition: A bold phrase at the start of a paragraph.
Text with a thick contrasting border, like a die-cut sticker.
A dark background used to make light work stand out.
A laptop frame displaying a website.
